title: The failures
creator: Lestat the vampire
why: This album, which is connected to the third season of 'Interview with a vampire,' means a lot to me. The whole series gave me a sense of belonging, and the third season and Lestat are something/someone I really relate to. I've played this album over and over, and the songs always make me want to dance and sing from the deepest parts of my heart.
imageAlt: Album cover of The failures by Lestat the vampire

title: Rex Laurent
creator: Olivia Rittenburg
description: 'Baroque shorty'
why: Rex has been an artist who never misses. Her songs always hit right. Her sound feels really special and unique, and I think that is why I am so drawn to her. Many of her songs have hit my heart, and I've sung them like I'm on stage performing (meanwhile, it's just me alone in my bedroom).
imageAlt: Rex holding a microphone with a silly smile

title: Cr1tter
creator: Payton Jane Clark (PJ)
description: Welcome to the cr1tter.n3t
why: Cr1tter... Cr1tter... Dear Cr1tter, her music instantly stuck with me when I heard my first song from her, which was 'motivational geeker'. She has a special sound that reminds me of the SoundCloud era, Juice WRLD, Lil Uzi Vert, Ski Mask the Slump God, XXXTentacion, and others. It's both playful and emotional at the same time, which feels exactly like me and the rap music I would have made if I ever started.
imageAlt: Cr1tter sitting down looking hella swag

title: Asal
creator: Asal Karimzadeh
description: kiss the sun
why: Asal, mhm, she is just a pleasure to my ears. Her voice and sound are just great, very unique and beautiful. She does various types of music, from melancholic singing to a little more aggressive/confident rap.
imageAlt: Asal smoking a cigarette looking cool

title: Nxdia
creator: Nadia Ahmed
description: Nxdia (pronounced Nadia) is a Cairo-born artist who turns diary writing and personal feelings into songs, pairing emotional openness with a playful connection to listeners.
why: Nxdia is one of the first queer artists who really stuck with me. Her music is great; it's freeing, playful, and emotional. Her overall vibe, even outside the music, is a true inspiration.
imageAlt: Nxdia covered in vines gazing at the camera

title: Jhadina
description: Jhadina shares conversations and spiritual reflections through Conversations with J and projects including Nuggets of Divinity.
why: I started watching Jhadina's videos around September 2024, when I was in a very emotional and transformative period of my life. She helped me see things clearly and move forward. Her presence has been with me throughout these past two years. I always find my way back to her videos when I need clarity, or just someone to help me move forward and confirm my intuition. I have a strong love and appreciation for her.

title: Freya Ray
description: Freya Ray describes herself as a storyteller and creator. Her work includes channeling, tarot, writing, and visual storytelling.
why: I first found Freya in March 2025. She was like a light in the dark. She is an incredible guide, and the way she uses her words is wonderful. She is poetic but direct. Her messages are usually very clear, and she is very clear about her intentions too. She has made me work harder on myself, and she is a huge inspiration for this whole project. The day I found out she is friends with Jhadina, I was flabbergasted. It felt like the whole universe was connected.
imageAlt: Freya reading a book looking beautiful and free

title: Eleni
description: Eleni Angeline shares intuitive content through her YouTube channel and connected social platforms.
why: Eleni popped up on my feed in the springtime of 2026. There is a specific video that I checked out just because of the viewer count, and I was amazed. I felt it all the way to my core. Then I almost started studying her content. Since she was a new channel, I could almost see her growth and progress, and how she was thinking before and during the video. It felt odd but also hopeful, like I myself could actually do this. She gave me hope that my life can actually be whatever I want it to be. After watching her content for a while, I can say that she is truly a beautiful, kind, and benevolent soul that I actually want to follow.
imageAlt: Eleni holding a rose, looking cute
